name: Compose and realise a large ensemble work
short_description: Compose and realise a large ensemble work once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can compose and realise a large ensemble work in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Compose and realise a large ensemble work means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Compose and realise a large ensemble work in a fresh real-life scenario.
